import pytest

from stack import Stack


def test_push_pop_order():
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1)
    s.push(2)
    assert s.pop() == 2
    assert s.pop() == 1


def test_peek_returns_latest_without_removing():
    s = Stack()
    s.push(1)
    s.push(2)
    assert s.peek() == 2
    assert not s.is_empty()


def test_is_empty():
    s = Stack()
    assert s.is_empty()
    s.push(1)
    assert not s.is_empty()


def test_empty_pop_and_peek_raise():
    s = Stack()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        s.pop()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        s.peek()
